newsitem.title: PORTUGAL: Portugal Telecom shares heavily traded.
newsitem.headline: Portugal Telecom shares heavily traded.

text.p: Heavy turnover in Portugal Telecom shares in early trade on Lisbon bourse may be linked to the sale of a stake by a key shareholder, dealers said.

"Everything indicates that the sale of almost 600,000 PT shares is linked to the departure of a shareholder with a significant stake in the company," said one operator, who asked not to be identified.
PT shares stood at 7,235 escudos, up 43 from the close, in turnover of 773,611 shares at 0945 GMT.
Dealers noted rumours in the market that Italian telecommunications company STET had sold its stake in PT.
"It would not surprise me if STET had sold its stake in PT," another operator said.
It was not immediately possible to confirm whether STET had sold a stake in PT.
